tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsal byed bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yo na mo na maḥ thig le chen po yig drug dang*/ /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ /zung 'jug de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /shes rab rgyud kyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ dpal sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs gnyis spyi khyab mtshungs pa las/ sdom chen la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la bsrung 'khor rgyas par na/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin bya ba dang*/ /rgyun gyi nyams len la bsrung 'khor bsdus pa sogs skabs su gang bab byed pa yin mod kyang chog sgrigs sogs kyi skabs su/ thugs dkyil gyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar khro rgyal rdo rje shugs khro bo bcu dang bcas pa tsam bsgom pa skabs su bab par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar blo la bzhag ste/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams/ sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bskyed pa yan chad thugs dkyil gyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin du bya la/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyong ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang*/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i brgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/

su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muts+tsha he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa a hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu ni/ rdo rje zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang*/ rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs byas te/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ /lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ pradzñā u pa ya/ āt+ma ka kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raṃ/ badz+ra amṛ ta swa bhā waṃ/ ku ru ku ru skan+dha dhā tu ā ya ta naṃ niḥswa bhā waṃ swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sbrul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum du dor te/

lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/ gnyis pa rigs drug 'god pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu zhags pa rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūṃ nag po las don yod grub pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar hoḥser po las rnam par snang mdzad rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gugadagra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣa sngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/

thams cad kyang so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing dkrug pa'i phyag rgya byas nas / oṃ hraḥsarba as+t+rā rā dza/ mā ra kle sha an+ta ka ra/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥkhats+tshe da ma ma ka raṃ bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la sogs pa rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su a i ṛ u l̥/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ a e ar o al/ steng gi tshigs rnams su ha ya ra wa la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su lā wā rā yā hā/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ āl au ār ai ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ l̥̄ ū rī ī ā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su hūṃ gi yi ge mthon mthing*/ zla ba ny-i ma sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag las grub pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gtsug tor nas brtsams te lus thams cad la reg cing*/ oṃ ā hūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na ā dhi pa ti badz+ra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raṃ/ badz+ra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa yan lag drug dgod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ oṃ hl̥ hri da yā ya na ma/ dpral bar reg nas/ oṃ hrūṃ si ra si swāhā/ gtsug tor du reg nas/ oṃ hriṃ shi khā yai bau ṣaṭa/ yan lag rnams la reg ste/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsā ya hūṃ/ mig gnyis la reg ste/ oṃ hrāṃ nai tra ya wa ṣaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyogs bcur brdabs la/ oṃ hraḥ.as+t+ra ya phaṭa/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya si raḥshi ka wa tsa nai tre/ a tra badz+ra/ ṣaṭa aṃ ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa bdud tshogs gzhom pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dha swa bhā wa sarba dharmān bi sho dha ya swāhā/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pra bodha ka sarba dharmān pra bo dhā ya swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmān pra dī pa ya swāhā/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmān badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wa rā ya/ i daṃ bā ling*/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da da ma he sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā da tu/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra kaḥ sarba satwā naṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ paṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣa/ a wa ra ṇa/ gub+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ satwā naṃ/ t+yak+t+wa ba h+ye maṇ+ḍal bhu myāṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra adzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ grong gi bdag po ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ bā ling*/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhuk+t+wa bitwa trib+tiṃ/ kri twa sarba satwā naṃ/ shān+hiṃ/ tsit+taṃ/ kri twa/ a pa ra s+thā naṃ/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā/ 'di ni sgrub mchod kyi bdag bskyed sogs la dgos kyi/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa'i skabs kyang 'di bor bas rung la byed pa'i lugs la'ang gang rung re byas na yang legs so/ /gnyis pa dngos ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥdamar po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ nag po las rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥser po las rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ ljang khu las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams su gyur/

de bzhin du/ las kyi 'khor lo rnams dang*/ bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams dang*/ dbang po rnams dang*/ las kyi dbang po rnams la rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng dang 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la bkod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ hrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥ ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba a ba ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka bigh+nan bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ/ da sha dika ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wak+tsit+tā ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhasmin ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs drag tu 'don no/ /drug pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu yangs ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ oṃ paṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dbus kyi lte ba'i nang du khru bcu gnyis pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ pad+ma'i lte ba khru bzhi pa'i steng du/ de dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa las/ sku mdog nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba can/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/

mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing*/ bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba cod pan la bcings shing*/ rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings bas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku gyur/ oṃ hūṃ kro dha in+d+ro3haṃ kro dhā nāṃ ādzñā dā ya ka swāhā/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du/ raḥyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha ya ra wa la brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ha hā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba mi bskyod pa lta bu dang gnod mdzes rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ steng dang 'og tu rtsibs kyi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la gnas pa'o// yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can don yod grub pa lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/

las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭak+ki rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ wu wū las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu dag lce dang chu lam nas spros he/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ ll̥ ll̥̄ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu dag bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/ thabs cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing*/ khro bo'i dbang po lta bu'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa tsakra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā uṣ+ṇi ṣa ur+dhi dī shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bigh+nan an+ta ka pūrba di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra krau dha rā dza dzaṃ bha ka duṣ+taṃ pradzñā an+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ waṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma an+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ laṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza staṃ bha ya ma an+ta ka pan+tsi ma di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ lā badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā bā la bā yaṃ byāṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ wāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la i shā na di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ rāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki nai ri t+yāṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇ+ḍa ag+ṇe yaṃ di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ hāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza sum+bha a dho di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba/ stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par gyur/ phur bu bsgril ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ka kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaṭa mu kha/ ṣaṭa bhu dza/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba bigh+nan bi nā ya ka ā di duṣ+tāṃ naṃ/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā nā ni/ kī la ya kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ll̥̄ badz+ra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāṃ/ si ra si kan+ṭhe hri da ye nā bhau gu h+ya/ an+te badz+ra kī la kā na/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣīṃ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ṃ k+ṣl̥̄ṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing*/ lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhiskā rā ya sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai wi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ha s+yaṃ tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra wa t+yaṃ tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de yan chan la/ rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa kho na dga' bas lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /bdun pa tshogs kyi zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/ brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swahā/ oṃ badz+ra mā le mā la ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī pa ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te nai wi t+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la ar+ts+tsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya was+t+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya ghaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra wa d+ye wa d+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kā me sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ kro dha a dī nāṃ/ badz+ra su ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/

/rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ / dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i/ /rtsa ba gsum dang phar phyin bcu/ /tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi bsten bgyi/ /mi dge bcu dang sgrib pa lnga/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang zag pa bzhi/ /deng nas brtsams te spang bar bgyi/ / bcu pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing*/ me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te/ chu la thim zhing*/ chu yang rlung gis bskams par byas nas rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a na bhiskaṃ ra dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog

thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru gzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyang steng dang 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du maṃ las ri rab lhun po'o/ /de'i steng du k+ṣaṃ las sna tshogs chu skyes lte bar pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du haṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/ lhun po'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la de nas 'di ltar/ bh+ruṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po zlum po sgo brgyad pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ ljang khu dang*/ nag po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang*/

ser po'i ra ba rim pa lnga lnga dang ldan pa ste/ sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang*/ sgo 'gram dang*/ sgo logs te glo 'bur gyi rnam par grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /ra ba'i phyi rol tu stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang*/ ra ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang*/ de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung rnams kyi bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po me long dang rnga yab dang bcas pa/ steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i bā ku li dang*/ steng du mdzes par tshar du dngar ba'i kra ma shir+ṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang*/ sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po bzhi bzhis btegs pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang myos pa srung ba dang*/ ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ 'og gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la brtsegs ma dang po'i logs gnyis nas glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dag dang*/ brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang*/ steng du har ma mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa/ bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang*/ snam bu rnams las dril bu dang*/ me long dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma nye bar dpyangs pa ste/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol sgo'i bar mtshams kyi rtsig pa'i ngos rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i phugs kyi zur rnams la/ rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa/

gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba la/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ / de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi ljang khu'i steng du ye shes kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba'i mu khyud ky-i nang mtha' la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi nag po'i steng du sa'i 'khor lo ser po 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi dmar po'i steng du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi dkar po'i steng du/ me'i 'khor lo dmar po/ rin po che'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi ser po'i steng du/ rlung gi 'khor lo nag po ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi sngon po'i steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang khu lte ba'i mu khyud kyi nang mtha' la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa ste/ 'khor lo thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa'o// de'i phyi rol rwa ba'i nang tshon sa'i khor yug ste/ de yang shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan dkar po/ /nub dang rlung ser po'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'og gzhi sngon po dang*/ de nas sa'i khor yug gi nang mtha'i bar gyi 'og gzhi'i kha dog kyang tshon sa dang mtshungs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ pad+ma dang*/ bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu sa'i khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang*/ bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi khor yug rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba ste/

de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /gtso bo'i gdan sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i lha gnyis bskyail ba dang*/ snying po'i pad+ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab ma dang*/ 'khor lo drug po'i rtsibs bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang sgo brgyad dang*/ mtshams brgyad de/ lha'i gnas bdun cu rtsa gnyis po rnams su/ dbugs bral gyi gdan re re'o/ /me dang rlung gi khor yug gi mtshams la/ shar du mdung gis 'bigs pa/ mer lhag ma can/ lhor ro bsregs pa/ bden bral du drag po'i g.yul/ byang du rul par gyur pa/ dbang ldan du byis pa shi ba/ nub tu rnag gi dri can/ nub byang du sbrul gyis zos pa ste brgyad tshan dang po dang*/ de dag gi bar bar du dur khrod gzhan brgyad de/ rlung gi g.yas su kang ka le dang*/ g.yon du ko la ha la/ dbang ldan gyi g.yon du ha ha sgrog pa dang*/ g.yas su drag tu rgod pa/ bden bral gyi g.yon du drag po'i sgra can dang*/ g.yas su pheṭa ka ra/ me'i g.yas su 'jigs rung dang*/ g.yon du 'jigs par byed pa ni brgyad tshan gnyis pa ste/ dur khrod chen po bcu drug mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs shing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam par mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ sa 'khor gsang ba'i byed dag pa/ /rga shi gzhu khyim 'gags pa las/ /skye rim rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ 'dod gzugs dzā lan+dha ra dang*/ /gang ba'i ri dang o rgyan rnams/ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /sa dkyil gsang gnas phyed gzhan la/ /skye ba sdig khyim 'gags pa las/ /dri med sa la sdud pa'i rim/ /go da wa ri dga' dbang phyug /lha mo'i mkhar dang ma la ba/ /

rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pas te/ /de ltar ye shes 'khor lo'o/ /chu dkyil lte ba'i phyed dang po/ /srid pa srang gi dus sbyor dag /skye ba'i rim pa 'od byed sa/ / arbu ta dang mum+mu ni/ au tre byed pa'i pā ṭa kaṃ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu 'khor lte ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /len pa bu mo rnam dag pa/ /'od 'phro'i sa la sdud rim ste/ /phur gsum las kyi pā ṭa kaṃ /ko sa lā dang lā ḍa ni/ /rlung phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /de ltar sa yi 'khor lo'o/ /chu 'khor snying ga'i phyed phye ma/ /sred pa seng ge'i khyim 'gags pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa sbyang dka'i sa/ /ka ling ha ri ke la dang*/ /zla ba'i gling dang lam+ba ka /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /chu dkyil snying ga'i phyed dag pa/ /tshor ba karka'i khyim gzhan ni/ / mngon gyur sa la sdud pa'i rim/ /kañtsi'i yul dang kod ka na/ /hi ma la ya bal po'i yul/ /rlung la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu yi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i 'khor lo phyed/ /reg pa 'khrig khyim 'gags pa las/ /skye rim ring du song ba'i sa/ /mā traṃ gri ha pra yā ka /ko la ki ri khyim gyi lha/ /dbang po la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i phyed gzhan la/ /skye mched drug dang glang khyim 'gags/ /mi g.yo'i sa la sdud rim ste/ /sau raṣ+ta dang kha che'i yul/ /gser gling sing ga la rnams ni/ /g.yo ba la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me yi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil dpral ba'i phyed dag pa/ /ming gzugs lug khyim 'gags pa ste/ /skye rim legs pa'i blo gros sa/ /na ga ra dang dbang chen drag /sin dhu ki rān ta yi yul/ /shar phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /rlung dkyil dpral ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /rten 'brel rnam shes nya khyim 'gags/ /chos kyi sprin chen sdud pa'i rim/ /ma ru'i yul dang ka ha ra/ /ku lu ta dang mahā mal/

/ rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pa bzhin/ /rlung gi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug tor 'khor lo'i phyed/ /'du byed bum pa'i khyim 'gags pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa kun tu 'od/ /tsā ri dra dang ke ra la/ /bhin da gzhon nu ma grong rnams/ / shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug tor phyed phyi ma/ /ma rig chu srin 'gags pa ni/ /bcu gnyis sa ste bsdud pa'i rim/ /rdul bral dang ni keng ka na/ /grong gsum shri ha ṭ+ṭa ka /nub byang la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /

'di rnams dag sbyor gyi don gal chen yin pas/ go zhing shes nas bsgom pa gal che'o/ / dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra ba la aṃ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ā+-i a aḥzhes pa rnams g.yas skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo l+la y+ya ḍ+ḍa k+ka kh+kha g+ga gha gha zhes pa rnams g.yas skor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྤ sa/ ha ya ra ba la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid ky-i ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haṃ yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing*/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang*/ lcags kyu/

g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ bdud kyi dga' ma dang*/ drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can mdun zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal bzhi char yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing rab tu khros pa/ ag tshom dang smin ma rab tu 'bar ba/ skra tshogs dmar ser gyi ral ba'i cod pan la/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang*/ dpral bar thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba phrag pa la 'phyang ba/ dbu la rdo rje dar dpyangs kyi steng du rdo rje zla ba phyed pa dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /de rnams re re la yang phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum/ gri gug

dmar po bzhis/ mda' rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhis 'khor lo mdung dbyug pa dgra sta rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje dril bu phub kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha phye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis gzhu zhags pa rin po che/ pad+ma/ dkar po bzhis/ dung me long rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser po'i sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing*/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral pa'i cod pan la bcings shing*/ rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kar+ṇa yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aṃ aḥkaṭ+yeṃ kan+ṭhe badz+ra me kha la badz+ra kan+ṭhi ke huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kau hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nū pu re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ baṃ pañtsa a ka ra mahā shū ṇ+ya swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarba aṃ ge bhasmi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aṃ ar+dha na rī shwa rā badz+ra ar+dha tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ūr+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swa ra e ka tri swa ra swa bhā wa badz+ra yadzño pa bī ta skan+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ k+ṣaḥdur dān+ta a bhi ma na k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri byā gra tsarma ka ṭau hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣa triṃ shad swa ra sap+ta ti hra swa dīr+gha byañdza na swa bhā ba dai t+ya ku la sha ta si ro bhi ra muṇaḍa mā le skan+dha a ba laṃ bhi ni skan+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hu hl̥ pañtsa skan+dha bi shud+dhi swa bhā ba shi ra si ka pā la mā le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ kro dha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khaṭ+ga hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tri shu la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bā' na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ang gu sha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ma ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mud gar hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kun da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra par+shu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra khe ṭa ka hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ka pā la hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra tsa pa hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra pā sha hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra rad na hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra pad+ma hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra shriṃ kha le hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hwāṃ tsa tur be da mu kha swa bhā ba prah+ma shī raṃ hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣā k+ṣi k+ṣī k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaḥ ha hā hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ sarba bigh+na bi dā ri ta ga dza tsarma pa ṭa ar tra rak+ta shra ba ta hūṃ phraiṃ/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭa mu ku ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣuṃ badz+ra bi dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra pa ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ h+yaṃ h+yāṃ badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍa la yau tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hraṃ hrāṃ badz+ra ba su ki shaṃ kha pā lau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yau tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ hwaṃ hwāṃ badz+ra a nan ta ku li ko me khā lā kan+ṭhi ka lau tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ h+laṃ h+lāṃ badz+ra tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nu pu ra yauḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar na phyag rgya phyag mtshan 'god par grags pa 'di dag 'di la nges par 'os bab yin pas gal che mod/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ma lcogs na yang mi 'gal tsam mo/ / de la 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang/ snyan dang*/ ske rgyan dang*/ zhabs gdub la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang*/ thod pa'i dum bu'i 'og pag dang*/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal gyis mdzes pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud cing*/ des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin phyis 'od gsal ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan brgyad ni pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/ shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor aṃ āḥ me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du haṃ haḥrnams las byung ba'i cang te'u rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ mer du ba ma/ bden bral du rmig sgyu ma/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma/ rlung du mar me ma ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ gcer bu dbu skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas cung zad steng phyogs su bskyod pa'i ḍa ma ru 'phrol zhing*/

g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ dum bu'i ske rags dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha'i tshogs dang*/ mgo bo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la/ hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba brgyad de/ shar du rkang 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang*/ lhor khrag 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang*/ byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang*/ nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa brgyad yang dag par gnas par gyur pa ste de dag ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ lhar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang ldog nas slar rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub sems kyi rnam par zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/

rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ /slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ /bhi pl̥̄ bṛ phū phu bri pl̥ bhā+-i/ /pl̥̄ bhi phū bṛ bṝ phu bhī pl̥/ 3 /ḍhi /'khor lo drug gi lha'i sa bon ni/ nya nyā ṇa ṇā ma mā na nā/ ྈྐ nga ngā ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣā/ rnams dang phyag mtshan gri gug dang rdo rje rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams su gyur pa/ gsang ba'i pad+ma las phyir spros te so so'i gnas su 'khod pa gyur pa ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar du shi rdo rje ma sl̥̄ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ nub tu sl̥ rdo rje ma la shī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung du sl̥̄ rdo rje ma la shi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du rdo rje ma la ༵ rdo rje 'khyud pa dang*/ mer shī rdo rje ma la sl̥ rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /sa khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs la/ dhi rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor dṛ rdo rje ma la thū rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du thu rdo rje ma la dṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ /nub tu rdo rje ma la dhī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung du rdo rje ma la dhi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du thū rdo rje ma la dṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du dṝ rdo rjes ma la thu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ mer dhī rdo rje ma la t-il rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /chu khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su/ bhi rdo rje ma la pl̥̄ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor bṛ rdo rje ma la phū rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du phu rdo rje ma la bṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/

nub tu pl̥ rdo rje ma la bhī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung du pl̥̄ rdo rje ma la bhi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du phū rdo rje ma la bṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du bṝ rdo rje ma la phu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ me mtshams su bhī rdo rje ma la pl̥ rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /me khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar du ḍhi rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor rdo rje ma la ṭhū rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du ṭhu rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ nub tu t-il rdo rje ma la ḍhā+-i rdo rje 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung du rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du ṭhū rdo rje ma la ḍ-ir rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du rdo rje ma la ṭhu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ mer ḍhī rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /rlung khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar du dzhi rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor dzṛ rdo rje ma la tshū rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du tshu rdo rje ma la dz+ṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ nub tu rdo rje ma la dzhā+-i rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung mtshams su rdo rje ma la dzhi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du tshū rdo rje ma la dzṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du dz+ṝ rdo rje ma la tshu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ me mtshams su dzhi rdo rje ma la rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la shar du ghi rdo rjes ma la kl̥̄ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ lhor gṛ rdo rje ma la khū rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ byang du khu rdo rje ma la gṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ nub tu kl̥ rdo rje ma la ghī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ rlung du kl̥̄ rdo rje ma la ghi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ dbang ldan du khū rdo rje ma la gṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/ bden bral du gṝ rdo rje ma la khu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang*/

me mtshams su ghī rdo rje ma la kl̥ rdo rjes 'khyud pa ste/ de ltar na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bdun bcu rtsa gnyis las/ shar dang shar lho'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog nag mo thabs dpa' bo rnams ser po/ lho dang lho nub kyi mkha' 'gro rnams sku mdog dmar mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams dkar po/ byang dang byang shar gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams dmar po/ nub dang nub byang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog ser mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams nag po'o/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang*/ gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad thung ba'i lus can g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' bo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi shes rab ma'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba glang lpags spangs shing mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ lhag ma brgyan dang cha byad bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'khor lo drug gi lha tshogs rnams/ shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i shar sgor nya rdo rje ma/ shar lho'i sgor nyā rdo rje ma'o/ /lho sgor ṇa rdo rje ma/ bden bral gyi sgor ṇā rdo rje ma'o/ /byang sgor ma rdo rje ma/ dbang ldan gyi sgor mā rdo rje ma/ nub sgor na rdo rje ma/ rlung mtshams kyi sgor nā rdo rje ma/ de ltar na phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi ljang khu/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi sngon mo/ thams cad kyang sgo khyud kyi nang mtshams na gnas pa'o// rlung dang byang gi mtshams su ྈྐ rdo rje ma sngon mo/ rlung dang nub kyi mtshams su

rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang shar gyi bar du nga rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang lho'i bar du ngā rdo rje ma sngon mo/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi bar du ha rdo rje ma ljang khu/ dbang ldan dang shar gyi bar hā rdo rje ma sngon mo/ bden bral dang lho'i bar du k+ṣa rdo rje ma ljang khu/ bden bral dang nub kyi bar du k+ṣā rdo rje ma sngon mo ste/ de ltar brgyad po rnams ni rtsig pa'i phyi rol sgo khyud rnams kyi bar gyi stegs bu la yang dag par gnas pa'o/ /de ltar na sgom mtshams ma bcu drug ni/ dur khrod chen po bcu drug la yang dag par spyod pa ste thams cad kyang cher khros shing drag mo'i tshul can 'khor lo dang mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa skra gyen la brdzes pa ste/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur lhag ma rnams ni/ nus ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ / da ni rjes 'brang gi lha rnams bskyed par bya ste/ phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu la klu rnams gnas pa ste/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma nag po la/ mkha' lding gdong ma dang lce spyang gdong ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ 'ug gdong ma dang stag gdong ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang*/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po la/ bya rgod gdong ma dang phag gdong ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang*/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po la/ khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ste/ klu rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi bum pa rdo rje pad+ma nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ rab gtum ma rnams khro mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil krung gis phan tshun du bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sgo'i g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu la/ shar du dri ma dang 'phreng ba ma nag mo/ lhor bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo/ nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang gu/ 'og tu 'dod ma dang glu ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad kyang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ / klu dang gzungs ma 'di rnams sdom chen gyi skabs 'dir/ dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang dang mi 'dra ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa nyis 'gyur brgya rtsa nyi shu'i lha la mi thi bas/ rtsa ba'i lha ma yin rjes 'brang gi lha tsam yin no/ /de'i phyir skabs 'dir sa bon nam/ skad cig tsam las bskyed na legs te thob tshod yin no/ /'on kyang chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che ba na 'di rnams kyang mkha' spro mdzad de de yang mi 'gal lo/ / rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sa bon dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa las byung ba'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dbang bzhi dang*/ gza' bcu dang*/ dhu wa dang*/ a gas+t+ya la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa skar ma thams cad dang*/ khyim bcu gnyis dang*/ cha bcu drug dang phyogs bcu skyong ba dang*/ dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can dang*/ bh+ring gi ni dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ pho nya thams cad dang*/ 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ skra'i grangs gyi grub pa rnams/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ mtshan ma sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/

oṃ su bi shud dha dharmā dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying gar rab tu zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣu k+ṣ+li las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣī las khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang*/ k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣar k+ṣo k+ṣal k+ṣaṃ las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣā+ai k+ṣār k+ṣā+au k+ṣāl k+ṣaḥlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang*/ k+ṣ+la las las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang*/ k+ṣ+lā las las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te/ slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pas yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/ lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dhū tī'i lam du hoḥyig dag dang*/ dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las/ byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ hoḥyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/

gtum mo shes rab gyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ / bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ / gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ / sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ / ces pa'i glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor la ོ'o zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can zhes 'don pa spo'o/ / yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/

de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa nam mkha' spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur gyi bar thugs dkyil gyi las rgyal mchog bzhin no/ / shi sl̥̄ zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ / lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba'i dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi yi bdag /lo gcig gi ni sna tshogs yum ste zhal la sogs pa rnam thar bzhi ni rnam par dag pa'o/ /sbyin pa sogs dang phung po 'byung ba yul dang yul can gzhan yang dbang po lnga la sogs pa dang*/ /phyogs sa phyogs kyi stobs dang dpal ldan rgyal sras dbang rnams kyis kyang mig ri lha mo rnam par dag /dpal ldan rdo rje can ni thugs kyi rdo rjer 'gyur te mi bdag dkyil 'khor sku yi rdo rje'o/ /lha rnams 'khor lo ā li kā li'i rigs skyes gsung gi rdo rje zla ba nyi ma'i steng du'o/ /de bzhin du ni ye shes rdo rje nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms sna tshogs yum gyi rang bzhin no/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi rdo rje yul dang yul can rnams kyi bgrod bya min pa rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje sems can thams cad rang snying skad rnams dag gis chos ni go bar byed pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi thugs kyi rdo rje sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rang bzhin mtha' dag sa la gnas/ /dri med nor bu lta bu dngos po rnams kyi 'dzin byed gang yin de nyid ye shes rdo rje'o/

/de nas <dus 'khor gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin/> bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra zhes pa rnams la/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa bhīska ra ya sa pa ri wā ra zhes 'dogs sbyor ba ni khyad par ro/ /sngags dbang blang bar 'dod na/ oṃ haṃ haṃ sogs kyis chu dbang gi don du gsol ba btab/ oṃ.a i ṛ ū l̥ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ des mtshon te cod pan dang*/ dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ ming dbang dang*/ oṃ e waṃ pad+ma badz+ra sogs kyis rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba btab/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣa dharma tsakra pra brta ka swāhā/ zhes pas rjes gnang gi dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sab+ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sap+ta bhū mi prab+tā+o3haṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /'di la 'og tu phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'i phyir gong ma bzhi po'i sngags dbang mi dgos la/ ci ste na phra thig mi bsgom pa'i rigs la ni de yang blang dgos so/ / de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba'i ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang zhes pa nas/ de la 'dud kyi bar du rgyas btab rnam pa bzhi dang*/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor nga rgyal bzung*/ mchod bstod rnams dus 'khor gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ huṃ phraiṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ huṃ phraiṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ / oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrā hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gzhan yang 'phreng ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i yan lag gi sngags rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa yang nges par bzla bar bya zhing*/

yang lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar gyi sngon 'gro bsdus pa de byas nas/ gzhal yas khang dang gtso bo'i skyed chog sngar bzhin dang*/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngal 'byin mi byed par/ sa bon tsam las bskyed/ thugs ka nas rdo rje shugs spros te/ ye shes spyan 'dren man chad gong bzhin byas pas chog la/ de las kyang bsdu na gtso bo yang sa bon phyag mtshan tsam las bskyed pa rung mod/ 'on kyang mngon byang lnga bskyed nyid bzang ngo*/ /bskyed chog 'di'i rigs la gtso bo nus ma dang bcas pa yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yin/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs bskyed pa nas brtsams te las rgyal mchog tu byed/ lha dgu'am gtso rkyang lta bu bsgom na/ ye shes spyan 'dren man chad las rgyal du byed pas/ sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa'i dag bya dag byed rags pa rnams/ rgyas bsdus de dag tshun chad la tshang bar shes par bya'o/ /de las kyang bsdus pa rnams la ni yan lag bzhi pa'i don mi tshang yang*/ spyir bskyed chog bsdus pa dang dbu ma'i don tshang na gtso bo'i don sgrub pa la mi bslu bas/ bskyed rim gyis dgos pa grub par shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni sgrub thabs kyi phyogs la thun mong min pa'i khyad par rnams bstan zin to/ / da ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim spyi la go ba chags pa sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir 'di la cung zad dpyad par bya ste/ sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs gsal byed grags chen po/ glo bo 'bris lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub kyi yi ge de/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yin yang zer te/ rtsa 'khor lo drug gi lte bar rgyal ba rigs drug dang*/ rtsa 'khor drug la 'khor lo drug gi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams dang*/ bu ga re la dur khrod kyi lha mo gnyis gnyis te bcu drug bkod/ nus ma dang thod pa yang gsang ba'i 'khor lor bkod pa'i lus dkyil zhig byas de la gzhan gyis rgol du dogs nas rig bzo med rgya dpe bzhin yin zer ro/

/spyir sdom chen 'di bde mchog mngon brjod 'bum pa nas gsungs pa yin pas/ lus dkyil 'byung du rung ba'i rigs su 'dug kyang da lta yod pa'i rgyud dang sems 'grel las lus dkyil gsal bar ma gsungs shing*/ man ngag gi rgya gzhung tshad ldan yang mi 'dug pa dang*/ gal te lus dkyil zhig 'byung na rtsa 'khor lo drug la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo drug bkod pa'i sbom yor de tsam ma yin par yul chen zhe brgyad dag pa'i sku'i cha so sor lha zhe brgyad bkod pa cig yong thang ba la/ de ltar mi snang ba dang*/ rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma tshad ldan rnams kyang*/ lus dkyil gyi spros pa mi mdzad pas/ re zhig de ni btang snyoms su bzhag go /'bris lo nas brgyud pa de ka'i dbang du byas nas/ gu ge grags rgyal gyis sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs brtsams pa na/ dpa' bo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad chad/ 'khor lo drug gi rnal 'byor ma zhe brgyad la/ zhal gnyis phyag bzhi byas pa sogs shin tu nor ba che/ de ni 'bris los mkha' 'gro bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad ces bshad pa de mkha' 'gro ma kho nar 'khrul/ yab kyi zhal phyag ston byed rnams lha mo'i yin par nor ba'i rtsing chos so/ / 'khor lo re la sa bon brgyad brgyad las med pas/ lha bcu drug mi dgos so snyam pa cig go ba 'dra ste/ sa bon re re las yab yum kha sbyor re skyed dgos pa ma shes par zad do/ /lar 'bris lo'i yi ge na/ phyi dkyil rang la'ang ma dag pa cung zad yod do/ /lugs de la brgyud pa ni/ dpe med mtsho/ gnyis med dpal 'dzin/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bi k+ṣ+yā ta/ kha che paṇa chen/ bhū mi shrī/ sha shwa ta pa/ a pa ra karmi ta/ 'bris lo zer ba yod cing*/ de rjes chos 'dzin pa/ ngag dbang pa/ byang seng pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen sogs nas brgyud pa yod zer/ rje grol mchog gis kyang gsan 'dug a brka rmi zhes pa a bha ya ka rar byas ni shin tu 'khrul lo/

/de bas khungs che ba/ yar klungs lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'ang yod de/ dus zhabs che chung*/ nā len dra pa/ sau ri pa/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas/ byā ya ka pa/ da sha ba la bi khyā ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ bim la shrī/ shung ke lo tsā ba/ zhes pa yod cing*/ de nas ci rigs par gyes mod kyi/ lo mchog pa/ bag ston pa/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ 'u yug pa sangs rgyas bzang po/ gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ kyegs gnas rnying ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla chen grags rin pa/ nam mkha' tshul khrims pa/ smrar ston rgyal 'od/ gong ma tshes lnga pa'i bar du brgyud cing*/ de las brgyud pa'ang rung ba'i skabs yod par snang mod/ rang lugs ni yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho 'gram du ba tshwa'i khron pa gang la rko ste/ byin rlabs zla bral tshig don gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po nyid dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang las brgyud pa nyid yin no/ /yang sdom chen la shin tu rtsal 'don mdzad pa/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gis rje phyogs pa'i dngos slob rgyal ba jo bzang pa la gsan pa nyid gtso bor mdzad la/ yang byang sems rgyal yes/ rje 'phags 'od/ rje bu ston/ mkhan chen dharma shrī nas brgyud nas/ chos rje yon tan 'byung gnas pa la'ang gsan nas cher spel/ de nas shangs ston kun dpal ba nam mkha' dpal bzang ba brgyud/ shes rab bkra shis pa la rje grol mchog gis gsan/ de ltar brgyud pa sna tshogs 'dug mod kyang*/ 'bris blo nas brgyud zer ba de/ dbang gi rgyun rang ni yod pa'i rigs su 'dug na'ang*/ lag len dbang bskur yang*/ dus 'khor rang lugs kyang ma yin/ 'phreng ba'i lugs lta bu zangs mar sbyar ba yang ma yin pa'i 'dra min cig las med/ brgyud pa gzhan rnams dus 'khor rang lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa yin/ lar dus 'khor 'gyur byed lo tsā ba so so rnams las/ 'bro lo dang*/

yar klung lo tsā ba gnyis la dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang rgyun byung*/ gzhan snga rabs pa mang po zhig la/ dus der yod pa'ang srid mod/ rgyun dang yig rigs med la/ rwa lugs/ rtsa mi lugs/ chag lugs sogs la ni/ spyir dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyun man ngag 'phrin las cher byung yang*/ dkyil 'khor 'di'i sgos kyi dbang rgyun med do/ dpyad pa gcig go /sdom chen gyi gtso bo 'di/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba de kho na yin la/ he ru ka'i nang nas rdor sems he ru ka yin/ dpal rdo rje shugs ni mi bskyod pa he ru ka ste/ spyir he ru ka la nang sel rigs drug yod kyang*/ he ru kar 'jog byed kyi sgo nas/ mi bskyod pa'i he ru ka nyid he ru ka dngos gzhir byed pas/ dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /zhes rdo rje shugs rang la he ru kar gsungs pa yin no/ /dpyad pa gnyis so/ /sdom chen gyi sku'i rnam pa la/ 'ga' zhig dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes su bzhed de/ rdo rje shugs dang mtshungs pa'i legs cha tsam yod kyang*/ 'di gshegs khro sems dpa' gsum gyi nang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kho na yin pas/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gshegs pa la/ ral pa'i thor tshugs nyid dgos par mngon/ rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyang thor tshugs nyid bzhed cing*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i thugs dam bris sku la/ dbu skra thor tshugs kyi kha dog dmar ser du yod do/ /spyir khro bo rnams kyi dbu skra'i kha dog gi skabs/ ser skya ser po dmar ser khams ser rnams dgos don gcig go /de'i phyir smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser cung zad byed pa sogs kyang dgos la/ sku sbom thung sogs ni mi bya ste/ dus 'khor sna tshogs gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /dpyad pa gsum pa'o/ /zhal so so la nyams tha dad byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dpyad pa bzhi pa'o// yum gyi sku mdog skabs/ 'jigs dus rtse mo can mtshungs mkha' 'gro ma la'o dag byed/

/ces gsungs pa'i don la kha cig bskal me'i tha ma de nam mkha'i khams yin pas ljang khur yod dgos/ des na yum ljang khu'o zhes 'chad pa ni/ sdom pa chung ngu'i yum ljang khur bshad pa dang mtshungs pas legs pa ltar snang ba zhig byung yang*/ 'jigs dus kyi me mkha' khams kho na yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing*/ mkha' khams kyi me ljang khu'i rgyu mtshan med la yum ljang khur 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang med do/ /gal te snga ma 'thad na 'jigs dus kyi sprin yang ljang khur 'gyur bas/ dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs par gsungs pa thams cad ljang khur thal lo/ /yang kha cig lung de la brten nas sku mdog dmar mor mdzad de/ 'di dag 'jig rten grags pa'i tshad mas sgrub ste/ tshig de'i don yum kyi sku mdog la sbyor na lung don de 'grig la/ bde mchog bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa las kyang*/ yum dmar mo 'dam kha la rung bar gsungs pa dang mthun zhing*/ nag po thabs kyi gsung la/ dmar mo shes rab kyi gsung gis rgyas 'debs pa'i dag sbyor yang yod mod kyi/ 'dir yum la 'chad srid na ni/ sku mdog la mi sbyor te/ dper na rdo rje phag mo sku mdog nag ser dkar mo sogs la'ang*/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba zhes 'byung ba dang 'dra ste/ gzi brjid drag shul che ba'i dpe'o/ /de ltar na yang 'gyur rnying 'ga' zhig las dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zhes pa yod pa dang*/ phyis kyi rgya dpe ma dag ces grags pas 'di gtso bo'i sku mdog ston byed du 'chad pa ngos bde'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug khyab byed kyi lha la/ khyab bya khams drug phan tshun gyi lha sbyor tshul de rtsi mi dgos pas/ 'dir yang sna tshogs gtso bo bzhin du/ yab sku mdog sngon po dang*/ yum ser mo ste/ 'di dang dus 'khor phyag nyer drug pa la dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /dpyad pa lnga pa'o/ /'khor lo drug po la/

'ga' zhig phyi rol kyi mu khyud byed pa na mi 'thad de/ rgyud 'grel las ma gsungs shing*/ thig gi skabs su 'khor lo re re cha chung drug par yin pa las/ gnyis re lte ba dang bzhi re rtsibs su gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lte ba la phyag mtshan gyi 'phreng ba yod pas na/ mu khyud yod na de la yang dgos pa las/ de 'dra ma bshad pas so/ /dpyad pa drug pa'o/ /yang kha cig dur khrod bcu drug ces pa/ sgo brgyad dang stegs bu brgyad po rnams nyid yin par 'dod pa ni me rlung gi khor yug la dur khrod yod par dus 'khor chen po'i dkyil 'khor las gsung pa dang 'gal zhing*/ sgo khang dang stegs bu de dag la dur khrod kyi rtags mtshan/ mi ro dang*/ keng rus la sogs pa 'god na ni/ sngon med pa'i gtam yin zhing*/ 'god du mi rung na ni dur khrod zer ba'ang bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /des na shar sgo'i dur khrod ces sogs gsungs pa ni/ shar sgo'i thad kyi khor yug yin pa sogs la dgongs pa yin la/ rtsa thig gi phyi rol phan chad dur khrod kyi bdag mo mkha' 'gro rnams rgyu zhing spyod pa'i gnas yin zhing*/ de rnams kyi bzhugs gnas sgo mtshams su byed pa yin te/ de rang la ltos pa'i yang gtso bo dang nye ba'i phyir/ gnas kyi mchog yin pa dang*/ sgo mtshams rnams stong par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang gzhal med khang rtseg pa sgo dang bcas pa mi sgom na ni/ 'khyams dang 'byung bzhi'i khor yug kyang med pas/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la dur khrod rnams 'byung ste/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro bcu drug rnams kyang dur khrod nyid na gnas so/ / gzhal yas khang sgo can yod med la dur khrod dang dur khrod kyi bdag mo 'god tshul mi 'dra ba 'di ni/ dus 'khor gyi sdom pa che chung dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs khyabs 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi dkyil 'khor te gsum ka la'ang 'dra'o/

/bde mchog bsdus pa'i skabs sems 'grel las/ khwa gdong ma shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen por kun du spyod/ ces sogs gsungs pa la/ dus khrod kyi sa mtshams ci ltar yin/ phyis kyi dus 'khor ba kha bo can rnams la dris na/ oṃ tig pa yod yod mi 'dra'o/ /dpyad pa bdun pa'o// yang 'khor lo drug po re re bzhin/ rang rang gi sum cha lte bar 'dod pa ni/ 'khor lo nang ma kho na dang*/ 'khor lo rim pa gcig pa 'ga' re la/ de ltar gsungs pa'i rigs 'gre kha thal ba ste/ 'khor lo rim pa mang po'-i rnam gzhag la blo kha ye ma phyogs pa'o/ /gal te de ltar byed na/ 'khor lo phyi ma rnams la de dang der bzhugs pa'i lha rnams rang gi gnas dang mtshams par bsgom na ni/ gtso bo sku tshad shin tu chung zhing*/ 'khor lo phyi ma rnams kyi lha rim pas je che je cher song bas shin tu mi rigs shing bkra mi shes par 'gyur la/ yang gtso bo las dpags te 'khor rnams chung bar byed na ni/ 'khor lo phyi ma rnams kyi rtsibs la lha rnams bkod pa na yang*/ 'khyams stong pa chen po rer mi re bsdad pa ltar shin tu mi mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /des na gtso bo'i gnas dang*/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang*/ 'khor lo so so'i rtsibs kyi rgya rnams mnyam par byed pa nyid gtso che'o/ /dpyad pa brgyad pa'o/ /yang 'di yod de 'di'i sgrub thabs cho ga rgyas pa la/ rgyal mchog gnyis kar du/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod byed/ de'i nang gi yang*/ las rgyal la dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i skabs sam/ rgyas btab kyi rjes su byas kyang rung ba man ngag yin zhing*/ 'bring po la las rgyal gyi skabs su mi dgos pa dang*/ bsdus pa la ni phyag rgya rgyan bkod med kyang chog go /zhes pa rang lugs blo la bzhag dgos shing*/ rdo rje shugs la phyag rgya rgyan bkod mi rung ba'i sgrub byed du/ rdor shugs 'jigs byed tha dad yin zhing*/ rgyan bkod 'jigs byed kho na la yin/

der ma zad mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa sogs gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i skabs su bshad kyi/ srung 'khor gyi skabs su ma yin zhes grub mtha' 'cha' ba rnams kyis sdom chen la rgyal mchog gnyis gyis skabs su/ rgyan bkod byas na dgag pa de rang la bzlog par 'gyur te/ de ni mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog dgos pa'i don gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed la yin gyi/ sdom chen gyi bskyed rim la ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir phyogs pa'i sgrub thabs na yang med do/ / bdag po rnam grags ni khas blangs snga ma de bzhed bzhin du/ sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gtso bo la rgyan bkod mdzad pas nang 'gal gyi skyon de yang 'jug la/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sna tshogs gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod byar rung par gsungs pa la mi 'thad de/ dus 'khor ni phyag mtshan dang dus gcig bsgom dgos pas phyis de dag 'god pa mi 'thad cing*/ sgrub thabs dngos gzhi'i skabs 'di dag tu bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes 'gog bzhin du/ sdom chen gyi rgyal mchog dang po la de ltar mdzad pa ni/ rgyan dgod kyi don ma dgongs shing*/ ha cang brjed ngas ches pa dang*/ rnal du mi gnas pa'i gtam ste/ sdom chen la yang rgyu mtshan de'i phyir phyag rgya rgyan bkod mi 'thad par thal bas so/ /spyir rgyan bkod kyi don sngar gang yang med pa la/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan gsar pa g.yog pa'i don ma yin gyi/ sngar bskyed zin pa rnams sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i don no/ /des na gnod byed de mi 'jug cing*/ bdud bgegs tshar gcod pa'i don yin pas/ spyir sna tshogs gtso bo dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis kar la rung zhing*/ phyag nyer drug pa la lhag par yang gal che ba yin no/ /de'i phyir rdo rje shugs la yang rgyan bkod nges par 'thad de/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i dgos pa'i don la mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/

/dper na go bgos shing mtshon cha bstar ba'i las de/ g.yul du 'jug pa thams cad la dgos kyi/ dum bu g.yul du 'jug pa la ni dgos/ skyong ba la mi dgos pa'i khyad par med pa bzhin du/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod de yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bdud 'jom pa la dgos/ rdaur shugs kyis bdud 'jom pa la mi dgos pa'i khyad par mi 'thad do/ /des na rnam rtog cig gis cig shos bcom pa'i tho cho'i rjes su mi 'jug par shing rta chen po'i gzhung srong pa nyid legs so/ /dpyad pa dgu pa'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i dag bya dag byed mdo tsam ni/ mngon rtogs kyi dkyus la 'don pa de dag yin la/ rnam pa'i dag sbyor rgyas pa ni rgyud 'grel nyid las shes par bya'o/ /dag bya dag byed kyi gtso bo dag rdzogs smin gsum sbyor tshul ni/ phal cher dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs dang gcig pa nyid de/ phal cher ni cho ga lnga gcig pa kho na yin la/ dkyil 'khor spro ba'i skabs su/ mngal gyi zla ba bcu ma rig pa la sogs pa snga phyi'i rim pa ma 'khrugs par 'di la sbyor du mi rung bas/ spyir 'khor lo drug gi khyim bcu gnyis dang dus sbyor bcu gnyis sbyor ba tsam yin gyi zla ba'am go rim sgrig mi dgos la/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la/ las rgyal gyi skabs su lha tshogs spro ba'i rim pa snga phyi thams cad bsdoms nas khams lnga'i lha tshogs spro ba'i rnam gzhag byed pa bzhin du/ 'dir rgyal mchog gnyis kar du byed de/ mngal du khams lngas bsdus pa'i lus ngag sems gsum 'phel ba rnams sbyong byed dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha tshogs spro ba dang*/ mngal nas btsas ma thag pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i rlung rgyu ba rnams sbyong byed las rgyal mchog gi spro ba rnam pa lnga'o/ /dus 'khor rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang*/ khams lnga'i lha tshogs spro tshul 'dres mar yod kyi/

khams so so'i sde tshan med pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang yin mod/ de la ye shes nam mkha'i khams gcig tu brtsi ba'am/ ye shes kun khyab tu byed pa gnyis ka mi 'gal yang*/ rnam gzhag snga ma ltar gtso che bas nus ma dang*/ dur khrod kyi lha mo rnams nam mkha'i sde tshan yin/ lhag ma 'khor lo bzhi po la 'byung chen gyi dbang du byas na/ 'khor lo bzhi 'byung ba bzhi dang sbyor/ 'byung phran gyi dbang du byas na/ shar dang me'i lha rnams rlung sogs phyogs kyi rim pa 'byung ba bzhi dang sbyor ba yin/ mkha' ye'i 'khor lo gnyis ni bzhugs gnas kyi dbye bas/ mkha' ye'i sde tshan du'ang bsdu/ sku mdog gi dbye bas 'byung bzhi'i sde tshan du'ang bsdu bas phyogs gnyis kar bstan pa'o/ /nus ma rnams ni sku mdog so sor yod kyang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin pas ye shes su'ang 'gyur mod/ skabs 'gar nam mkhar yang byed pas der yang 'gyur mod/ gtso bo dang lhan cig skyed pa'i phyir/ spro ba rnam pa lnga'i lha la mi the'o/ /dpyad pa bcu pa'o/ /'dir cho ga rgyas pa'i skabs/ zhu ba glus bskul la/ spyan ma dag ni 'gro ba'i yum sogs byed pa nyid bzang*/ bsdus rgyud kyi tshig kho nas kyang*/ cho ga 'bring po man chad la legs mod kyi/ kha cig mno' na/ sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha la spyan ma sogs yum lnga dngos su med pas/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /zhes sogs zer du mi rung snyam pa yin na ni/
