yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma btang ste sa bslang ba/ bdud tshogs bsreg pa dang*/ sa'i lha mo la gnang ba zhu ba dang*/ sa gzhi bya bas sbyang ba/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa yan chad/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rgyas pa srung ma drug cu bsgom pa byas kyang legs mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang rgyas bsdus 'grig pa'i phyir/ thugs dkyil sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ rdor shugs khro bcu dang bcas pa tsam bsgoms na legs pas/ haṃ las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin nas/ tsakra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas phur gdab ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol gyi bar/ dkyil chog ma mo dang 'dra de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa byin rlabs pa nas bzung*/ sa'i lha mo sa la bstim pa dang*/ gtor 'bul dang*/ smon lam bkra shis sogs kyang dkyil chog bzhin bya ste/ nyi ma dang po'i bya ba'o/ /de nas nangs par sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ sdom chen nyid kyi sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed rnams byas nas/ mdun bskyed oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ tshom bu dang bcas pa'i steng du nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo he ru ka 'khor lo drug gi sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyogs kun tu nas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum nus ma bcu/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mnyam par sbyor ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ dur khrod skyong ba'i rnal 'byor ma bcu drugagazungs ma bcu gnyis/ gtum mos 'khyud pa'i klu brgyad/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag / ces pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byaid gyur

cig / ces pa'i bar/ dpal sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa rdzogs par 'don/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam zhes pa nas/ slob dpon chos seng mkhas grub sangs ye dang*/ /byams pa'i mtshan dang rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bud+dhā ya nas/ oṃ dzñā na pa ra mi tā ya na maḥ oṃ tshu tshū dzṛ dz+ṝ dzhi dzhī ya yā na maḥ oṃ ṭhu ṭhū ḍhi ḍhī ra rā na maḥ oṃ pl̥ pl̥̄ phu phū bṛ bṝ bhi bhī ba bā na maḥ oṃ thu thū dṛ dṝ dhi dhī la lā na maḥ oṃ kl̥ kl̥̄ khu khū gṛ gṝ ghi ghī ha hā na maḥ oṃ sl̥ sl̥̄ shi shī haṃ ha na maḥ oṃ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣā nga ngā ྈྐ na nā ma mā ṇa ṇā nya nyā huṃ hūṃ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa phaṭa na maḥ hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ ha na maḥ h+ya h+yā hra hrā h+la h+lā na maḥ¿ na maḥ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yo na mo na maḥ zhes pa nas/ bstod pa dang snyan mnan pa dang*/ rjes chog kyang dkyil chog bzhin no/ /de nas bum pa lhag gnas sogs rdzas lnga sta gon dang*/ slob ma lhag gnas dang*/ mal stan lhag gnas kyi bar du yang khyad par med de/ nub gnyis pa'i bya ba'o/ /nyi ma gsum pa dang bzhi pa lnga pa'i bya ba yang phal cher 'dra'o/ /'on kyang thig gdab pa dang tshon gyi dbye ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di dkyil 'khor cung zad rgya chung bas/ bcu gnyis pa la thig gdab 'dod pa ma nu'i nyin zhag dag la dpal ldan rdul tshon dbye ba nyid/ /ces pa de dgos sam mi dgos snyam na/ thob thang la bshad tshod bzhin dgos te/ dus de dag la bya ba de rnams 'os shing shis pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ las tshar mi tshar kho na'i dbang du mdzad pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi bar du gzhan bzlas brjod dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus 'da' ba yin no/ /deng sang de lta bu mi byed pa ni/

chog gra ba rnams kyi brel ba gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ 'di la ni chos kyi gleng brjod byed sa med do/ /de'i phyir cho ga yang gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i nyi ma la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor lus la bsdu ba'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs brjes pa tsam mo/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ / zhes pa'i bar thugs dkyil dang*/ sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs sbyar te shes par bya'o/ / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma hūṃ dang phraiṃ las lhar gyur pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ zhes pa nas/ de dag ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin no/ /lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su/ shi sli/ zhes pa nas/ k+ṣa k+ṣa rnams dang*/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dang gri gug rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar du/ shi rdo rje ma la/ zhes pa nas/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rab 'byams rgya mtshos bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor du ha las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba'i ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa

nas/ gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam zhes pa nas/ mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / ces pa'i bar du dkyil chog tu bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ na maḥchen mo sta gon gyi skabs bzhin 'don pa spo/ de nas sdom chen nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa/ yang 'don par bya/ de man chad gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ bdag 'jug dang*/ rjes chog dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar du/ rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ci rigs tsam ma gtogs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil chog dang khyad par med do/ /ci ste slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su/ lha ngo ston pa na 'don pa spos la gzhan gsung dbang kho na bzhin du bsgrubs na yang mi legs pa ma yin mod/ stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog dang*/ rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa'i/ sgrub thabs kyi rjes 'brang rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil chog na yang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor rnams phyag gnyis pa byed pa dang mthun par dbang bskur ba'i lha yang phyag gnyis par mdzad de/ de dang 'di yang rigs mtshungs pas na 'dir yang phyag gnyis pa byas na legs te/ 'di skad ces/ yum lngar gyur pa ni/ gtsug tor du mkha' khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar rlung khams sgrol ma nag mo ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ mgrin par me khams gos dkar mo dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar chu khams mā ma kī dkar mo/ tho ba dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte ba sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo/ 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang thugs kar 'khyud rgya mdzad cing pad ma'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ zhes bya zhing*/ cod pan gyi skabs sangs rgyas lnga yang des rigs 'gre ba la/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs pa

zhes bya/ dar dpyangs kyi skabs/ shar lhor rus sbal gyi rlung du ba ma nag mo/ lho nub tu rtsangs pa'i rlung smig sgyu ma dmar mo/ byang shar du lha sbyin gyi rlung mkha' snang ma dkar mo/ nub byang du nor lhas rgyal gyi rlung mar me ma ser mo/ steng du srog 'dzin gyi rlung mchog gi cha ma ljang khu/ 'og tu thur sel gyi rlung thig le ma sngon mo rnams cang te'u thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams 'dzin cing*/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing skra grol ba'o/ / rdor dril gyi skabs su/ yab phyag nyer drug pa dang*/ yum phyag gnyis ma bskyed/ brtul zhugs ky-i skabs/ rna ba'i gnas su rna ba'i dbang po phyag na rdo rje ljang khu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yul sgra sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ kun tu bzang po 'dra ba zhes dang*/ snying gar yid kyi dbang po kun tu bzang po sngon po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yul chos chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra ba/ zhes lhag por brjod cing gzhan rigs lnga yab yum dang 'dra/ yab rnams rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi dang yum rnams pad ma'i skyil krung pad zla la bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ rnam grangs mi 'dra ba la/ mig gnyis su mig gi dbang po sa'i snying po dmar po/ me'i mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhes byas kyang rung*/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste 'dir ma smos/ ming dbang gi skabs/ khro bo gtsug tor can dang khro mo drag can ma gnyis ka ljang khu yin/ des mtshon pa'i lag pa dang*/ rkang pa'i lha la'ang khro bo yab yum sku mdog mtshungs/ rmugs byed ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa byas kyang chog smra ba shin tu brtson 'grus ma dang*/ bshang ba 'dor ba rengs byed mar byas na yang legs so/ / thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen brdzes/ phyag g.yas phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar gtod pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/

g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la gnas pa'o/ / zhes brjod/ rjes gnang gi skabs kyang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' dang ye shes kyi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngo sangs gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rigs lnga dang 'dra/ spyir 'di dkyil chen rang yin mod/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang bstun na/ dkyil 'khor 'di dag cung zad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga'ang cung zad bsdus pa legs par 'gyur na/ slob ma bdag nyid gtso bo phyag gnyis pa kho nar bskyed/ rdo rje bzhir bskyed pa bor/ rjes gnang gi skabs su phyag mtshan 'khor lo gcig pus chog 'dogs la chos bshad kyi rjes gnang dang sngags dbang tsam byed/ dag pa'i chos bshad la rdor dril sbyin pa'i skabs/ rdor sems yab yum du mi bskyed par/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes sbyin/ dbugs dbyung ring po yang mi dgos so/ kha skongs kyi cho ga gzhan yang bzhag tu yod mod kyi/ ha cang bsdus pa yang mi legs pas 'tsham par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rnams kyi nges gsang 'di/ /byis pa'i blo can rnams kyi yul min mod/ /'di tsam rgyud 'grel don du 'gyur snyam nas/ gzhan la phan phyir cung zad bshad pa yin/ /dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bshad pa 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ /bdag gis ni 'di'i sgos kyi dkyil chog ma mthong ste/ gsung dbang gi dkyil chog ny-id 'di la sbyor ba yin/ sgrub thabs la rgya gar ba nā ya ka shrīs mdzad pa dang*/ bal po rā ma a tsar yar grags pa/ shrī ta nu bha dras sbyar ba/ yod 'dug ste/ bod du ma 'gyur ba 'dra/ mthong ni ma mthong*/ yar klungs lo tsā ba dpon slob kyi tho chung 'dra yod zer/

phyis gsang bu brag nag pa ngag dbang grags pas kyang sgrub dkyil gnyis ka yod zer/ kun mkhyen chen po las brgyud pa rje phyogs pas sgrub thabs che chung gnyis mdzad/ bu ston chen po'i dngos slob stag tshang ba rin chen dbang phyug gis sgrub thabs dang bstod pa mdzad/ zhe slob yon tan 'byung gnas pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod/ gzhan yang rje shes rin pas byas pa dang*/ mkhas pa dbang phyug grags dang glo ston lo tsā'i rjes su 'brang zer ba/ mkhan chen kun rgyal ba'i byas pa dang*/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags bzang rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ glo bo 'bris lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub kyi sgrub thabs kyi tho dang*/ lus dkyil gyi tho sogs yig sna thor bu 'ga' dang*/ de'i rjes 'brang du rlom pa gu ge grags rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs dang 'phreng ba dang 'dra min gyi dbang gi tho yig sogs kyang mthong mod/ gtso bo dkyil 'khor 'di ston byed kyi rgyud 'grel nyid dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa'i 'grail bshad du ma bklags cung zad nges pa rnyed de bkod pa yin no// //bkra shis/ zhus dag dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsal byed bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/
